rationale: This law review article examines U.S. antiterrorism detention policy, Combatant Status Review Tribunals, military commissions, and coercive interrogations at Guantanamo Bay. It is completely unrelated to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01) and is a normative legal argument rather than an empirical study or systematic review.
